title: The lead agent made short: twice as fast and 60% cheaper, still safe; the judge told that length is not understanding
request: The owner approved the fixes of the lead agent's weak points on practice people (34 s a turn, 17 repeated questions on the sealed set, the route only tied with Claude alone); later: only $13 left, optimize the runs. Then the owner marked 7 practice papers (the judge agreed 0.65, kinder to the lead agent, which wrote about 750 words a conversation against about 100) and approved making it short.
spec: Diagnose on the practice runs, fix with code where code can decide, measure on the same practice people, keep only what measurably helps.
plan: Profile the practice runs: turn seconds, calls per turn, tools per call
Read the repeated questions in practice conversations
Keep or undo by the numbers

decisions.decision: Code reads the shared table at the start of a turn
decisions.why: the context already showed the columns, yet the agent spent a call on read_table; reading by code records the table as computed so its counts may still be said

decisions.decision: A confirmation question right after a go-ahead is refused
decisions.why: most repeats in the practice runs came right after 'go ahead', 'run it' or 'stop asking'; a question about something the work truly lacks is still allowed

decisions.decision: At most two table queries a turn, kept by code
decisions.why: after the table was read by code the agent queried far more (98 queries in 10 conversations); the prompt already asked for one or two
the right route fell from 0.90 to 0.70 on the same 10 people in both runs that used it

decisions.decision: Practice exam runs think at high effort, sealed runs at extra-high
decisions.why: the owner, with $13 left; the thinking summary is still asked for and kept whole

decisions.decision: Messages of about 80 words, never more than 120, one idea and one question
decisions.why: the lead agent wrote 7 times more than the others; the owner stopped labelling at a 1,783-word conversation; long messages slow it, cost more and earn the judge's points without understanding

decisions.decision: The judge is told that length is not understanding
decisions.why: on the owner's 7 papers the judge was kinder to the long lead agent; re-judged with the rule, agreement rose from 0.65 to 0.71 (EUR 0.04)

change: dclab_rnd/agents/case_agent.py (goes_ahead, CONFIRMS, the go-ahead refusal in ask, QUERIES_A_TURN, the code read of the table at turn start); dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation_exam/__init__.py (practice_effort); tests/test_case_agent.py (SpeedAndGoAheadTests, QueryCapTests), tests/test_conversation_exam.py (PracticeEffortTests); prompts case_agent.md (short messages) and exam_judge.md (length is not understanding)

findings.defect: My first guess of the slowness was wrong
findings.scenario: only 3 of 659 calls held a message beside notes; 91 calls held notes only
findings.cause: a turn usually spends one call on notes and one on the question
findings.fix: the prompt asked for notes in the same reply (later undone with the rest of the prompt change)

findings.defect: Reading the table by code made the agent query the data far more
findings.scenario: CEX-014: 98 table queries in 10 conversations, 37 s a turn
findings.cause: with the table's columns in context and no read_table result, the agent looked at the data through queries
findings.fix: at most two queries a turn, refused with a reason after that

findings.defect: The go-ahead list missed 'send it now'
findings.scenario: CEX-014 d-31: the person asked three times to send the table; the agent kept asking side questions

findings.defect: The prompt change lowered the right route
findings.scenario: d-04 and d-31 lost the right route in CEX-014 and CEX-015 (0.90 to 0.70 on the same 10 people)
findings.cause: not isolated; the prompt change is the common part of both runs
findings.fix: the prompt change undone; the code limits kept
findings.test: the free gates rerun on the restored prompt

findings.defect: The judge rewarded the lead agent's long messages
findings.scenario: owner's 7 practice papers: lead agent 0.62 by the owner, 1.00 by the judge; Home and Claude alone the other way
findings.cause: long messages touch more points and the judge counted them as shown
findings.fix: the judge's prompt: length is not understanding; the lead agent's prompt: short messages
findings.test: re-judging the 7 papers: agreement 0.65 to 0.71; harness and agent-eval pass

findings.defect: The lead agent asked for a yes after the person had said yes
findings.scenario: practice d-06 (CEX-012): four 'give me one plain yes' turns before the build; sealed v2 clear requests 0 of 2; blind pairs and a second labeller named it
findings.cause: says_yes refused any message holding a delay word anywhere ('hold the holdout until ...'), so request_build was refused and the agent asked again; it also wrote 'Shall I build now?' in its text after a go-ahead
findings.fix: a leading yes or the build named counts unless a refusal is aimed at building; after a go-ahead, confirmation questions are dropped from the message (kept when they were the whole message)

findings.defect: The number check cut the heart of an answer and left a fragment
findings.scenario: CEX-018 d-36: only 'Does that cover what you need?' reached the person; d-15: the table was dropped and the next turn apologised
findings.cause: sentences with numbers nobody gave or code computed are dropped; when they are the answer, the rewrite can still fail and the leftover question is sent
findings.fix: the rewrite names the numbers allowed (exactly as the tools returned them, or the person's own; otherwise words); a rewrite left with questions only or mostly cut gets one stricter try

measurements.name: CEX-014 (prompt change, table read by code, go-ahead guard)
measurements.gate: faster and no worse than CEX-012 on the same people
measurements.result: 37 s a turn (32 before), route reached 0.70 (0.90), repeats 0.5 (0.3), 10 of 12 people within EUR 2.83

measurements.name: CEX-015 (plus two queries a turn and 'send it now')
measurements.gate: faster and no worse than CEX-012 on the same people
measurements.result: 32 s a turn (same), EUR 0.19 a person (0.24 before), repeats 0.3 (same), route reached 0.70 (0.90), understanding 0.92 (0.94)

measurements.name: CEX-016 (short messages, high effort for practice)
measurements.gate: faster and cheaper, still safe, no worse on the route than CEX-015
measurements.result: 16 s a turn (32), EUR 0.08 a person (0.20), 331 words a conversation (645), 0 invented numbers, option fit 4.5, understanding 0.94 by the fairer judge, route reached 0.83 (0.92 in CEX-012, 0.75 in CEX-015), repeated questions 0.58 (0.33)

measurements.name: the 7 papers re-judged with the length rule
measurements.gate: agreement with the owner at least 0.70

measurements.name: CEX-018 (the yes fix) on 8 practice people
measurements.gate: fewer yes-after-yes turns; clear requests passed
measurements.result: d-06: build recorded after 2 turns (7 before), 1 yes request (4 before); route 7 of 8; clear requests 4 of 6 (the two misses from the number check, F7); 0 invented numbers

measurements.name: CEX-019 (the number-cut fix) on 4 practice people
measurements.gate: d-15 and d-36 answered, still no invented number
measurements.result: d-36 and d-15 clear requests now passed (both failed in CEX-018), repeated questions 1 to 0 each, 0 invented numbers; d-31 and d-04 unchanged

measurements.name: blind pairs by three Claude models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku), run by the owner
measurements.gate: a human-free second view of lead agent vs Claude alone
measurements.result: all three agree on 6 of 8 pairs; by majority the lead agent wins 6 of 8, Claude alone 2 (one is the yes-after-yes bug, now fixed)

outcome: The lead agent is now short: about twice as fast and 60% cheaper on the practice people, still without an invented number; repeated questions rose and the route is one person short of CEX-012, both to watch. The judge agrees with the owner 0.71 on 7 papers with the length rule.
lessons: Measure the cause before fixing: a count of tools per call showed my first guess was wrong
A change that removes one round trip can add others: the agent filled the gap with queries
Keep code limits that save money; undo a prompt change that lowers the route, even when it was meant to help
A person who labels finds what a model judge misses: here, that length was being rewarded
risks: Ten people per run: a two-person route difference is within noise, but it appeared in both runs
The speed problem remains (about 32 s a turn)
Short messages and high effort changed together, so their shares of the speed are not separated; repeated questions rose to 7 in 12 people
